use: Official identification, 125 Pioneer Plaza address, W. Scott Dunne and C.A. Goetting, and 1929–1930 dates. The locator uses the actual mapped theatre footprint.
The City distinguishes its Plaza Theatre property and stage annex at 125 Pioneer Plaza from the adjoining Centre Building at 123.
Full-resolution primary photograph of the restored public facade. The photographer caption gives 1927, while the official registry establishes 1929–1930.
Written technical venue data on auditorium and stage arrangement and the restored standing building.
